title: Document local debugging workflow: tracing, admin endpoint, logs
description:
Write docs/debugging.md: how to set RUST_LOG for verbose output, how to use the admin /log-tip endpoint to inspect group state, how to use `transit peer-list` to diagnose propagation issues, how to query the SQLite databases directly (which files, which tables, useful queries). Artifact: docs/debugging.md.

Acceptance: document covers all three debugging tools; includes example commands and expected output; explains how to find the SQLite database file path from config
